description: Quick - Set Blind Kit 14' - 16' Boats, Mossy Oak Bottomland The product that started it all Avery Outdoors began with the vision to build products for waterfowl hunters created by waterfowl hunters. Cover it all up with the Nylap and heavy - duty netting combination of the CamoNet and you are ready to hunt.
